The following events took place in '''5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] saved [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] from [[Death/Legends|death]] by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Pter Nyklas]]. Solo was discharged from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and escaped [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>
*Short-lived uprising against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[Montellian Serat/Legends|Montellian Serat]], on the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="THG" />
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] won the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> from [[Cix Trouvee]].<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*[[Kyle Katarn]] entered the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].<ref name=":0" />
*[[Rokur Gepta]] used his [[electromagnetic torpedo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], [[Destruction of Tund|eradicating all life there]].<ref name=":1">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] ended his second [[tour of duty]] and was promoted commander of the ''[[Pride of the Senate]]''.<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places this event two years before the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] that takes place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
